item.text: I’ll trace the invoice export’s pagination and deletion filtering, compare it with the project export path, and make the smallest fix that preserves the existing export behavior.

item.text: The invoice export stops after its first page because deleted rows are filtered before the page size is counted. I’ll make invoices use the same larger scan limit as projects, so a deleted record can’t make the first page look like the end of the export.
